body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress the numerical penalties from one Light physical Wound Condition until the start of your next turn; gain +1 Fortitude against forced movement during that time.

surges.html: Suppression lasts through the end of your next turn.
Suppress one ordinary Slowed or Poison Condition for the same duration.

rider.title: Adaptation - Bulwark
rider.html: Assume Lattice (upkeep 1): suppress one chosen Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties while this Adaptation remains. Missing structures, Critical effects and Wound spaces are unchanged.
